newsitem.title: USA: Zurich firm has 19.95 pct LaserMaster stake.
newsitem.headline: Zurich firm has 19.95 pct LaserMaster stake.

text.p: Sihl-Zurich Paper Mill on Sihl AG said Thursday it has acquired a 19.95 percent stake in LaserMaster Technologies Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Comission, the Zurich-based specialty paper and coatings manufacturer said it bought the stake on September 16, paying with a $6 million promissory note.
Under a purchase agreement, the Swiss firm acquired the equivalent of 2,742,858 common shares of LaserMaster. The stake consists of 1,371,429 shares and warrants to buy 1,371,429 additional shares.

Following the purchase, the Swiss firm and LaserMaster signed a strategic alliance and collaboration agreement aimed at facilitating the development and marketing of specialty coated media, according to the filing.
